video_title: Landry Shamet, OG Anunoby and Tyler Kolek Postgame Media | Novemebr 2, 2026

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on his past experiences playing against OG Anunoby
quotes.excerpt: I felt like he always went at me early in my career every time we played them.
quotes.quote: When I was younger, my only notion of him was he was really hard to guard and I felt like he always went at me early in my career every time we played them. I used to hate it. He would score, talk a little shit. So that was my only notion of him.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet admits he used to hate playing against OG Anunoby early in his career because he was so hard to guard. Shamet says he would score and talk a little shit every time they played.

structured.context: Landry Shamet discusses his past experiences playing against OG Anunoby early in his career.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on OG Anunoby's selfless team-first mentality
quotes.excerpt: This guy just wants to win. He wants to do whatever he can for this group.
quotes.quote: That's who he is. This guy just wants to win. He wants to do whatever he can for this group, for his teammates, sacrifice himself. He'll play, stand out there for a minute and a half or two minutes and get subbed out. A lot of guys in the NBA, the reality is you get subbed, you're pissed, you're like, this is bullshit. But he never has any of those moments. He's just like, what can I give this team?
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet praises OG Anunoby for his selfless team-first mentality noting that he never complains about being subbed out and is always focused on what he can give to the team.

structured.context: Landry Shamet praises OG Anunoby for his selfless attitude and willingness to sacrifice for the team.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the importance of learning to play without the ball
quotes.excerpt: I remember growing up playing full court three-on-three with no dribble, so you just learn how to move.
quotes.quote: I remember growing up playing full court three-on-three with no dribble, so you just learn how to move without the ball. I'm lucky I had that implemented from a young age and I wish more kids would do that moving forward in today's game, because I think it really helps you learn how to play and understand how to move and get open.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet says he wishes more kids would learn to play without the ball by playing full court three-on-three with no dribble, a skill he says helped him understand how to get open.

structured.context: Landry Shamet explains the importance of learning to move without the ball during his youth.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the team's need for continued improvement
quotes.excerpt: I don't think anybody in this locker room is satisfied with where we're at.
quotes.quote: I think we got to win and I think it's still early in the season and I don't think anybody in this locker room is satisfied with where we're at. Happy to be in the win column tonight, but I can point to 10 things offensively and defensively that we need to improve upon.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet says the Knicks are not satisfied with their current level of play despite the win, noting he can point to 10 things offensively and defensively that the team needs to improve.

structured.context: Landry Shamet reflects on the team's need for improvement despite being in the win column.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the mental aspect of defending in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There's a massive mental piece with defending in the NBA.
quotes.quote: There's a massive mental piece with defending in the NBA and I feel like settling into understanding personnel, the game, situations, time and score, fouls, just all of it. Once you're exposed so many times to different scenarios, you just kind of get a better feel. Once you do that, you can kind of let your physique and your body do the rest.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet on the mental side of NBA defense: Once you are exposed to different scenarios enough times, you get a better feel and can let your physique and body do the rest.

structured.context: Landry Shamet discusses the mental aspect of defending in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on Tom Thibodeau's adaptability as a coach
quotes.excerpt: One thing about Tom Thibodeau is he's adaptable. He's willing to change and make different moves.
quotes.quote: One thing about Tom Thibodeau is he's adaptable. He's willing to change and make different moves if need be. He's not going to just say one thing and be stuck on that.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet says Tom Thibodeau is adaptable and willing to change his approach when needed, noting that the coach is not going to just say one thing and be stuck on that.

structured.context: Landry Shamet comments on Tom Thibodeau's ability to adapt his coaching strategies.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on managing pressure as defending champions
quotes.excerpt: By just knowing it's a new season and knowing you want to beat them too.
quotes.quote: By just knowing it's a new season and knowing you want to beat them too. That's what the competition is, not being fazed by or disgruntled by, just going out there and trying to win the game.
quotes.social_post: OG Anunoby on the mindset of defending champions: It is just a new season and you want to beat everyone. You just go out there and try to win the game.

structured.context: OG Anunoby explains how the team manages the pressure of being defending champions.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on the sustainability of the team's fourth-quarter performance
quotes.excerpt: It's definitely sustainable. It's just sometimes shots just go in instead of not missing.
quotes.quote: It's definitely sustainable. It's just sometimes shots just go in instead of not missing. So we made shots, put a pace by getting stops or running transition. By us making shots and then missing shots, how it goes sometimes.
quotes.social_post: OG Anunoby says the Knicks fourth-quarter performance is sustainable, noting that sometimes it just comes down to whether shots go in or not.

structured.context: OG Anunoby discusses whether the team's fourth-quarter performance is sustainable.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on the impact of a short off-season
quotes.excerpt: We had a very short off-season and I mean I think everyone's kind of a little bit tired.
quotes.quote: We had a very short off-season and I mean I think everyone's kind of a little bit tired. So I don't know, I don't know how to answer that, but we definitely played until June and I think everyone feels it.
quotes.social_post: OG Anunoby admits the Knicks are feeling the effects of a short off-season after playing until June, saying I think everyone is kind of a little bit tired.

structured.context: OG Anunoby comments on how the short off-season has impacted the team's fatigue levels.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on the coaching staff's communication
quotes.excerpt: We have great coaches. They do a great job communicating to us what we need to be doing.
quotes.quote: We have great coaches. They do a great job communicating to us what we need to be doing on the court and then guys are executing defensively and then we're getting stops. I mean I think that's always our goal, so we're not thinking about it, but I think there's always room for improvement though. So always striving to be better.
quotes.social_post: OG Anunoby credits the coaching staff for clear communication on defensive assignments, but emphasizes that the team is always striving to be better.

structured.context: OG Anunoby praises the coaching staff for their communication during games.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Kolek
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Kolek on staying ready for fourth-quarter opportunities
quotes.excerpt: It's life in the NBA. You get opportunities and you take advantage of them when they're presented.
quotes.quote: It's life in the NBA. You get opportunities and you take advantage of them when they're presented and I feel like I did that. But a guy comes back and the coach makes a decision and you just got to be ready for whatever comes.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Kolek on his rotation status: It is life in the NBA. You get opportunities and you take advantage of them, but a guy comes back and the coach makes a decision and you just have to be ready.

structured.context: Tyler Kolek talks about the reality of NBA rotation changes and staying ready for opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Kolek
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Kolek on the coach's confidence in the roster
quotes.excerpt: It shows he has confidence in me and I think he has confidence in every guy.
quotes.quote: It shows he has confidence in me and I think he has confidence in every guy on this roster. They can come in as he's shown, he'll throw any guy in at any time to be the spark and tonight I happen to be one of those guys.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Kolek says Tom Thibodeau has confidence in every guy on the roster and will throw anyone in at any time to be a spark.

structured.context: Tyler Kolek discusses the confidence Tom Thibodeau shows in the entire roster.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Kolek
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Kolek on his role when entering the game
quotes.excerpt: I don't need to do anything spectacular, you know, just get our guys organized, get good shots.
quotes.quote: I don't need to do anything spectacular, you know, just get our guys organized, get good shots, push the pace, be solid on defense. Nothing out of the ordinary, I would say, just be myself.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Kolek on his role off the bench: I do not need to do anything spectacular. Just get our guys organized, get good shots, push the pace, be solid on defense and just be myself.

structured.context: Tyler Kolek describes his approach and role when he is subbed into a game.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Kolek
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Kolek on the team being a work in progress
quotes.excerpt: It's early in the season. I think everything's a work in progress.
quotes.quote: It's early in the season. I think everything's a work in progress. Last year, I feel like we probably hit our best stride in the playoffs, so we were a work in progress the whole year. But that's the nature of the NBA season. You got to keep getting better each and every day, each and every game, and then be ready to go when it's go time.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Kolek says the Knicks are a work in progress, noting that the team hit their best stride in the playoffs last year and must keep getting better each day.

structured.context: Tyler Kolek reflects on the team being a work in progress early in the season.
